summary: Added Namespace.__contains__ in rdflib/namespace.py so `ref in ns` performs a prefix test (str(ref).startswith(str(self))), returning False for non-string inputs. Overrides str's substring-based containment. Includes a doctest-style docstring. Not run or tested per instructions; not committed. NamespaceManager.__contains__ from the spec was not implemented; it can be added on request.
